accessibility.aria: Semantic HTML/ARIA labels, descriptions and live status announcements.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus. Escape closes overlay/remote keyboard mode. Closing overlay returns focus to invoker.
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard traversal; logical tab order; no keyboard trap except modal/drawer focus trap.

buttonRenderingRules: Relevant action for an object kind stays visible when blocked by state and renders DISABLED with a machine/human readable reason.
Action irrelevant to the object kind MAY be absent; the UI must not invent a disabled pseudo-action.
Danger actions use danger styling and cannot be default keyboard action.
Pending action cannot be double-submitted; idempotency still remains server-side mandatory.
A disabled action must expose its reason in text/tooltip and accessible description; primary blocking reason also appears inline.
No optimistic UI may render a terminal success before canonical server outcome.
Conflict refresh preserves unsent OWNER input in a local comparison buffer; it does not auto-merge noncommutative changes.

buttonStates.CONFLICT: Stale stateVersion/revision/binding/epoch. UI nenabizi blind retry; nejprve refreshne canonical snapshot a zachova OWNER vstup pro porovnani.
buttonStates.DISABLED: Akce je pro dany object kind relevantni, ale current stav nebo chybejici vstup ji blokuje. UI MUSI zobrazit konkretni duvod; samotna seda barva nestaci.
buttonStates.ENABLED: Akce je semanticky aplikovatelna, current server snapshot splnuje guardy a povinne vstupy jsou lokalne validni.
buttonStates.FAILED: Zobrazi stable error code, lidske vysvetleni, correlation a presnou recovery akci.
buttonStates.MANUAL_REVIEW: Automaticky retry je zablokovan. UI zobrazi evidence, unknown effect a explicitni OWNER rozhodovaci akce podle operation contractu.
buttonStates.PENDING: Command byl odeslan nebo accepted. Tlacitko ukazuje spinner/progress, nespousti druhy command a podle operation contractu nabizi Cancel.
buttonStates.SUCCEEDED: Zobrazi se az po canonical persistovanem outcome/postcondition. Lokalni callback, toast nebo HTTP 2xx samy o sobe success nedokazuji.

CODE_50.rule: JSON, schema, payload, manifest, diff nebo kod. Editor nikdy neorezava platny obsah podle poctu radku; 50 radku je navrhova kapacita, business limit urcuje operation schema.

SECRET_1.rule: Token, heslo, API key nebo jina jednoradkova tajna hodnota; reveal/copy je samostatna explicitni UI akce.

SECRET_50.rule: Privatni klic, certifikat nebo multiline secret. Obsah se nesmi trimovat, normalizovat ani formatovat bez explicitniho contractu.

TEXT_1.rule: Jednoradkovy identifikator, nazev, URL, klic, filtr nebo kratka hodnota. Enter nesmi vytvaret novy radek; podle kontextu submitne formular nebo nema efekt.

TEXT_2.rule: Kratke vysvetleni, poznamka, duvod nebo focus message. Auto-grow do 6 radku, pote vlastni vertikalni scroll.

TEXT_50.rule: Delsi prirozeny text: zadani, instrukce, specifikace, vysvetleni nebo dlouhy chatovy vstup. Nad 18 viditelnych radku se pouzije vlastni scroll; canonical operation schema muze povolit delsi obsah.

TEXT_8.rule: Stredne dlouhy business popis, runbook poznamka, popis integrace nebo shrnuti zmeny.

validationPipeline: CLIENT_SHAPE: required/type/basic format/size for immediate feedback; never authoritative.
SERVER_AUTH_SESSION: current OWNER session/API boundary and CSRF where applicable.
SERVER_OPERATION_SCHEMA: canonical payload schema, reserved fields, business constraints.
SERVER_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT: OWNER intent, operation context, target/argument provenance, Secret-use context.
ADMISSION: deadline, recovery barrier, capacity, concurrency/idempotency guards.
DISPATCH: side-effect intent/outbox/fence according to canonical operation.
POSTCONDITION: read-back/evidence/reconciliation; only persistovaný canonical outcome may render success.
